note: starting_equity 10000->5000, max_collateral_pct_of_equity 0.60->0.50 (=$2,500 hard cap on total deployed capital, per sign-off), max_single_name_pct_of_equity 0.25->0.50 (matches the total cap rather than sub-capping at $1,250/name -- a single name isn't restricted below what the total cap already allows; with max_concurrent_positions=2 and the $8-$60 universe, actual diversification depends on how large the screener's proposed trades are, not a hard per-name ceiling below the total). max_concurrent_positions 6->2. quality_screen and min_yield_pct adapted from wheel-strategy sources the user supplied; see CLAUDE_OPTIONS.md Step 1/3 for rationale. min_trailing_eps_growth_pct is a trailing net-income-growth proxy, not the forward EPS growth the source actually screens on -- see Known gaps. covered_call_delta_range (2026-08-12): a lower, more conservative ceiling than the CSP delta_range, per sign-off -- once assigned, the priority shifts to minimizing further assignment (being called away) so the position stays alive longer toward zero cost basis (uncapped rolls once a lot is paid off -- see max_rolls_before_assignment below). delta_range (CSP) stays moderate/unchanged since assignment there is an accepted outcome, not something to screen against. secondary_csp_delta_range (2026-08-12): used for supplemental CSPs (opened while at least one lot is already held/being worked toward zero cost basis) and as the barbell's 'low_prob' leg (2026-08-19) -- per sign-off, opportunistic income shouldn't compete for attention with a position already in progress, so it carries a low probability of assignment. Set equal to covered_call_delta_range as a starting point; no source or math ties these two together, so they're free to diverge later. max_rolls_before_assignment 2 (2026-08-19 sign-off, was null): CSPs and not-yet-paid-off covered calls stop rolling and accept assignment/call-away after 2 rolls; a covered call whose lot has already reached zero cost basis (premium_agent.positions.is_paid_off) rolls uncapped instead, per sign-off #4 -- a paid-off lot is held indefinitely, continuing to earn covered-call premium and dividends as ongoing income rather than being freed up. post_assignment_max_collateral_pct_of_equity / post_assignment_max_single_name_pct_of_equity / post_assignment_max_concurrent_positions (2026-08-19 sign-off): once any lot is held, the total collateral cap widens from 50% of equity to 100% (i.e. total_equity minus capital already in use) for further supplemental CSPs, the per-name sub-cap tightens to 45% (was uncapped below the 50% total), and max_concurrent_positions rises from 2 to 3 -- see premium_agent.scan._remaining_budget / _effective_max_concurrent. Barbell entry (2026-08-19 sign-off, CLAUDE_OPTIONS.md 'Barbell entry'): the account's opening move, whenever no CSP leg is currently open anywhere, is now two simultaneous CSP legs -- delta_range ('threshold_of_risk') and secondary_csp_delta_range ('low_prob') -- splitting the remaining total collateral budget 50/50 (premium_agent.scan._open_barbell), rather than a single CSP at one delta target. Whichever leg assigns first starts its own independent payback counter (premium_agent.positions.breakeven_progress_pct, keyed per lot by the assigning CSP's instrument_id, not per symbol or per account) while the other leg keeps running its own CSP lifecycle unaffected.
